papers.title: Structure-Agnostic Protein–Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction via Hierarchical Representation Alignment
papers.summary: Abstract Motivation To enable real-world protein-ligand affinity prediction, not only out-of-distribution generalization but also robustness to variable structural availability and quality should be considered in model design. Results We present AlignNet, a hierarchical representation alignment framework that mitigates intra- and inter-molecular heterogeneity to learn robust protein-ligand embeddings for generalizable affinity prediction, even from sequence-level inputs. Its intra-molecular module projects unimodal and multimodal features into a unified space, aligning augmented multimodal views for feature fusion and unimodal with multimodal embeddings to distill multimodal priors for structure-agnostic inference. Its inter-molecular module aligns protein and ligand embeddings for cross-molecular integration. Extensive experiments show that AlignNet (i) achieves highly competitive performance, with up to a 20.4% gain in SCC on the challenging LBA 30% split under sequence-only settings, suggesting improved out-of-distribution generalization; and (ii) learns well-separated affinity-related clusters, supporting reliable structure-independent prediction. Availability and Implementation AlignNet is available at https://github.com/altriavin/AlignNet

papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
**摘要与动机**  
为了实现现实世界中蛋白质-配体亲和力的预测，模型设计时不仅需要考虑数据分布外的泛化能力，还需要具备对不同结构可用性及质量变化的鲁棒性。  

**研究结果**  
我们提出了AlignNet这一分层表示对齐框架。该框架通过减轻分子内部及分子间的异质性，能够学习出稳健的蛋白质-配体嵌入特征，从而实现基于序列信息的通用亲和力预测。其内部模块将单模态与多模态特征投影到统一空间中，通过对这些增强后的多模态数据进行融合处理，以及将单模态嵌入与多模态嵌入进行对齐，进而提取出与具体结构无关的先验信息用于推理。外部模块则负责对蛋白质与配体的嵌入特征进行跨分子整合。  

大量实验结果表明：AlignNet在仅依赖序列信息的条件下，在具有挑战性的LBA 30%数据集上取得了高达20.4%的性能提升，这充分证明了其出色的泛化能力；同时，该模型还能有效区分与亲和力相关的不同特征簇，从而支持可靠的、不依赖于具体结构的预测。  

**开源与实现方式**  
AlignNet的源代码可访问以下链接获取：https://github.com/altriavin/AlignNet

papers.title: Spatial-Spectral Fusion Enables Drug Repositioning by Capturing Indirect and Long-Range Associations in Biological Networks
papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Drug repositioning accelerates clinical translation by identifying new therapeutic indications for approved drugs. However, therapeutic associations in biomolecular networks often exist indirectly, through transitive chains and long-range mechanisms, rather than as directly observed links. Shallow methods are confined to direct similarity and miss such indirect associations, whereas deep graph neural networks suffer from over-smoothing and lose discriminative power in highly connected networks. Results We propose a spatial-spectral collaborative framework. In the spatial domain, a wave-evolution process propagates similarity from local to global, capturing multi-hop transitive associations while preserving discriminative representations. In the spectral domain, network-specific spectral transforms model global connectivity for long-range dependencies over homogeneous similarity and heterogeneous drug-protein-disease networks, with the two views aligned by contrastive learning. On three benchmarks the method outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on most evaluation metrics; case studies on Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s disease and molecular docking confirm its ability to recover non-explicit therapeutic associations. Availability The source code and data are available at https://github.com/Juniper-cola/BIO_SSF

papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
**摘要与动机**  
药物重新定位通过为已获批的药物发现新的治疗用途来加速其临床应用进程。然而，在生物分子网络中，治疗关联往往是通过间接途径、即通过传递链或长距离作用机制实现的，而非以直接可见的形式存在。传统的浅层分析方法仅能检测到直接的相似性，因此会忽略这些间接关联；而深度图神经网络在处理高度连接的网络时则容易出现过度平滑现象，从而丧失区分能力。  

**研究方法**  
我们提出了一种空间-谱协同框架。在空间维度上，通过波动演化过程将局部相似性传播至全局，从而捕捉多跳传递关系并保留网络的区分能力；在谱维度上，利用特定于网络结构的谱变换模型来描述长距离依赖关系——这些模型既适用于同质性的相似性分析，也适用于异构性的药物-蛋白质-疾病网络。通过对比学习将这两种分析方法有机结合在一起。在三个基准测试中，该方法在大多数评估指标上的表现均优于现有的最先进技术；针对阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病的案例研究以及分子对接实验进一步证明了该方法能够有效揭示那些非显而易见的治疗关联。  

**代码与数据获取**  
源代码及相关数据可访问以下链接：  
https://github.com/Juniper-cola/BIO_SSF

**摘要**  
肠道微生物群通过影响宿主的新陈代谢来影响癌症治疗的反应。尽管以往的研究主要探讨了特定微生物属与代谢物之间的关联，但目前尚缺乏有效的方法来识别那些能够系统性地调节整体代谢组的微生物属。因此，需要开发出可扩展的统计工具，以便在高维的微生物组-代谢组数据中找出这些具有系统调控作用的“关键因素”。

我们提出了B-MASTER这一基于贝叶斯的多变量回归框架。该框架结合了ℓ1稀疏性约束与ℓ2群体收缩机制，能够有效识别那些在跨代谢物调节中起核心作用的因素。通过使用吉布斯采样技术，该方法能够实现接近线性的计算效率，从而适用于包含数百万参数的复杂模型。理论分析也证明了B-MASTER方法具有后验概率收敛性和选择一致性等优势。通过对结直肠癌患者的微生物组-代谢组数据进行分析，我们发现了若干能够调控整体代谢模式及与癌症发展相关的特定微生物属，这些结果进一步揭示了微生物群在系统层面的调控机制。

药物重新定位通过为已获批的药物发现新的治疗用途来加速其临床应用进程。然而，在生物分子网络中，治疗关联往往是通过间接途径、即通过传递链或长距离作用机制实现的，而非以直接可见的形式存在。传统的浅层分析方法仅能检测到直接的相似性，因此会忽略这些间接关联；而深度图神经网络在处理高度连接的网络时则容易出现过度平滑现象，从而丧失区分能力。

all_papers.title: Structure-Agnostic Protein–Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction via Hierarchical Representation Alignment
all_papers.summary: Abstract Motivation To enable real-world protein-ligand affinity prediction, not only out-of-distribution generalization but also robustness to variable structural availability and quality should be considered in model design. Results We present AlignNet, a hierarchical representation alignment framework that mitigates intra- and inter-molecular heterogeneity to learn robust protein-ligand embeddings for generalizable affinity prediction, even from sequence-level inputs. Its intra-molecular module projects unimodal and multimodal features into a unified space, aligning augmented multimodal views for feature fusion and unimodal with multimodal embeddings to distill multimodal priors for structure-agnostic inference. Its inter-molecular module aligns protein and ligand embeddings for cross-molecular integration. Extensive experiments show that AlignNet (i) achieves highly competitive performance, with up to a 20.4% gain in SCC on the challenging LBA 30% split under sequence-only settings, suggesting improved out-of-distribution generalization; and (ii) learns well-separated affinity-related clusters, supporting reliable structure-independent prediction. Availability and Implementation AlignNet is available at https://github.com/altriavin/AlignNet
